title: Blood in the Grove
summary: Secure Blood Grove, then descend into Goblin Mines for your first chapter trial.

chain.title: Chapter I — First Blood
chain.description: Establish your first build, cross Lumo and Blood Grove, then break the Goblin Gate.
chain.goal: Reach level 10 and defeat the boss of Goblin Mines I.
chain.promisedReward: Choose one of three guaranteed Essences for your second slot.

choice.selectionSummary: Choose the Essence that will define or complement your two-slot build.
choice.confirmationText: This Essence will be awarded when you complete Chapter I.

options.title: Claim the Lumo Sentinel Essence
options.summary: A magical striker whose random targeting adds coverage while its defenses reward staying healthy.

options.title: Claim the Vampire Bat Essence
options.summary: A physical sustain option that heals from its attack and becomes evasive when wounded.

options.title: Claim the Nightshade Blossom Essence
options.summary: A magical control option that weakens enemies and supplies steady self-healing.

objectives.description: Win 4 encounters in Blood Grove without abandoning your developing build.
Break the Goblin Gate: complete Goblin Mines I and defeat its boss.
Reach character level 10 to unlock Crystal Creek and your second Essence slot.
